_comment: EXAMPLE REGISTRY — every entry here is fictional and exists only so that
hooks/term-scan.sh and tests/test-term-scan.sh are runnable out of the box.
Your real registry does not belong in a public repository. Keep it in a
private repo or outside version control entirely, and point the hook at it:
Note what the schema implies about the threat model: a registry of terms you
do not want published is itself a document describing what you consider
sensitive. Publishing the list to protect the list is self-defeating. The
scanner is the reusable part; the vocabulary is yours.
